name: Harissa Chicken & Chickpea Traybake
blurb: Rose harissa chicken thighs roasted with chickpeas, peppers and red onion.
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon
2 peppers and 2 red onions, in wedges
method: Rub the chicken with the harissa, half the oil and the lemon; leave 20 minutes.
Toss the chickpeas, peppers and onions with the rest of the oil and the cumin in a large tray.
Sit the chicken on top and roast at 200C fan for 35-40 minutes until charred and cooked.
Serve with dollops of yoghurt and plenty of coriander.

name: Sausage, Gnocchi & Tomato Traybake
blurb: Sausage meat, gnocchi and cherry tomatoes roasted together until crisp and sticky.
ingredients: 6 good sausages, skins removed, torn into chunks
1 tsp fennel seeds, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp olive oil
method: Toss everything except the mozzarella and basil in a large tray.
Roast at 220C fan for 25 minutes, stirring once, until the sausage is browned and tomatoes burst.
Scatter over the mozzarella and return for 5 minutes.
Finish with basil.

name: Salmon, Potato & Green Bean Traybake
blurb: Salmon roasted over crushed new potatoes and beans with lemon and dill.
method: Toss the potatoes with oil and roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Add the beans and lemon slices, sit the salmon on top and season.
Roast 12-14 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Scatter with dill and serve with crème fraîche.

name: Greek Lamb & Potato Traybake
blurb: Lemon-oregano lamb steaks roasted with potatoes, olives and feta.
ingredients: Juice of 2 lemons, 6 tbsp olive oil
method: Toss the potatoes with the lemon, oil, garlic and oregano in a large tray. Roast at 200C fan for 25 minutes.
Nestle in the seasoned lamb and the olives.
Roast 15-20 minutes more until the lamb is pink and the potatoes tender.
Crumble over the feta and rest 5 minutes.

name: Spanish Chicken & Chorizo Rice Traybake
blurb: Smoky one-tray rice with chicken thighs, chorizo, peppers and peas.
method: Brown the chicken and chorizo in a roasting tin on the hob, then stir in the onion, pepper, garlic and paprika.
Stir in the rice, pour over the hot stock, and arrange the chicken on top.
Cover with foil and bake at 190C fan for 30 minutes.
Stir through the peas, re-cover for 5 minutes, then rest and finish with lemon and parsley.

name: Roast Pork with Crackling & Apple Sauce
blurb: Slow-roast pork shoulder with crisp crackling, roast potatoes and gravy.
ingredients: Apple sauce: 3 Bramley apples, 2 tbsp sugar, knob of butter
Gravy: 1 tbsp flour, 400ml stock, splash of cider
method: Rub the skin with oil and lots of salt. Roast at 240C fan for 30 minutes, then 160C fan for about 3 hours until tender.
Turn the oven back up, parboil and roughen the potatoes, and roast in hot fat for 45-55 minutes.
Simmer the apples with a splash of water and the sugar to a sauce; beat in the butter.
Rest the pork 20 minutes; make gravy in the tin with the flour, cider and stock. Carve and serve.

name: Whole Roasted Baharat Cauliflower
blurb: A whole spiced cauliflower roasted until charred, with tahini and pomegranate.
ingredients: 2 tbsp baharat or ras el hanout
Tahini sauce: 4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, water
Seeds of 1 pomegranate, handful of parsley, toasted flaked almonds
method: Steam or parboil the whole cauliflower for 8 minutes, then drain well.
Rub all over with the oil and spice and sit in a tray.
Roast at 200C fan for 40-45 minutes until deeply charred and tender.
Cut into wedges and serve drizzled with tahini and scattered with pomegranate, parsley and almonds.

name: Jerk Chicken Traybake
blurb: Marinated jerk chicken thighs roasted with sweet potato, pepper and pineapple.
ingredients: 4 tbsp jerk paste (or blitz: 3 spring onions, 2 Scotch bonnets, 4 garlic cloves, 3cm ginger, 1 tbsp allspice, 1 tbsp thyme, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp brown sugar, juice of 1 lime)
method: Coat the chicken in the jerk paste and marinate at least 1 hour.
Spread the sweet potato and peppers in a tray with a little oil and roast at 200C fan for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and pineapple and roast 30-35 minutes more until charred and cooked.
Serve with lime wedges (and rice and peas if you like).

name: Roasted Veg & Halloumi Traybake
blurb: Mediterranean veg and thick halloumi slabs roasted with honey and oregano.
ingredients: 2 courgettes, 2 peppers, 1 red onion, 250g cherry tomatoes, chopped
4 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp dried oregano
method: Toss the vegetables with the oil and oregano in a large tray and roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Nestle in the halloumi, drizzle with the honey.
Roast 12-15 minutes more until the halloumi is golden and the veg is soft.
Serve with warm flatbreads and a squeeze of lemon.

name: One-Tray Lemon & Thyme Roast Chicken
blurb: A whole chicken roasted over potatoes, lemon and garlic — the whole dinner in one tin.
method: Toss the potatoes, garlic and half the lemon with the oil in a large deep tray.
Rub the chicken with butter and season; put the rest of the lemon and thyme in the cavity and sit it on the potatoes.
Roast at 200C fan for 75-85 minutes, basting once, until the juices run clear.
Rest 15 minutes; squeeze the roasted garlic and lemon over everything to serve.

name: Sticky Gochujang Chicken Traybake
blurb: Korean chilli-glazed chicken roasted with spring onion and sesame, over rice.
ingredients: Glaze: 3 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 3 garlic cloves, 2cm ginger
1 bunch spring onions, cut into lengths
Rice and quick-pickled cucumber to serve
method: Mix the glaze and toss with the chicken; marinate 20 minutes.
Spread in a tray with the spring onions and roast at 200C fan for 30-35 minutes, basting once, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with sesame seeds.
Serve over rice with pickled cucumber.

name: Cod, Chorizo & Butter Bean Traybake
blurb: Cod roasted on smoky chorizo, butter beans and cherry tomatoes.
ingredients: 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika
method: Toss the chorizo, beans, tomatoes and onion with the oil and paprika in a tray.
Roast at 200C fan for 15 minutes until the chorizo oil runs and the tomatoes soften.
Sit the seasoned cod on top and roast 10-12 minutes until it flakes.
Finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Tandoori Paneer & Pepper Traybake
blurb: Yoghurt-and-spice marinated paneer roasted with peppers and red onion.
ingredients: 3 peppers and 2 red onions, in chunks
150g thick yoghurt, 3 tbsp tandoori spice mix, 2 garlic cloves and 2cm ginger crushed, juice of half a lemon, 2 tbsp oil
Naan and mint yoghurt to serve
method: Mix the yoghurt, spice mix, garlic, ginger, lemon and oil and fold through the paneer and vegetables.
Marinate 20 minutes, then spread on a tray.
Roast at 220C fan for 20-25 minutes until charred at the edges.
Serve with warm naan and mint yoghurt.

name: Sausage, Apple & Red Cabbage Tray Roast
blurb: Sausages roasted with wedges of red cabbage, apple and red onion in balsamic.
ingredients: Half a red cabbage, in thin wedges
3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 1 tbsp honey
method: Toss the cabbage, apple and onion with the oil, balsamic, mustard, honey and thyme in a large tray.
Roast at 200C fan for 15 minutes.
Add the sausages and roast 25-30 minutes more, turning once, until browned and the cabbage is tender.
Serve with mash.

name: Maple-Mustard Chicken & Root Veg Traybake
blurb: Chicken thighs roasted with carrots, parsnips and new potatoes in a maple-mustard glaze.
ingredients: Glaze: 2 tbsp maple syrup, 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard, 3 tbsp olive oil, few rosemary sprigs
method: Toss the potatoes, carrots, parsnips and onions with half the glaze in a large tray and roast at 200C fan for 20 minutes.
Add the chicken, brush with the rest of the glaze, and roast 30-35 minutes more.
Baste with the pan juices and serve.
